content.user_title: Reduce SaaS Churn with Retention Flows
content.value_statement: Subscription teams lose revenue when cancellations and failed payments are handled too late. This skill designs clear cancel flows, targeted save offers, and dunning programs.
actual_capabilities: Designs cancel flows with exit surveys, targeted offers, confirmation screens, and post-cancel steps.
Maps cancel reasons to discounts, pauses, downgrades, support escalation, or graceful cancellation.
Builds dunning timelines with retry logic, payment update emails, and grace period guidance.
Defines churn risk signals, health scores, and proactive retention interventions.
Recommends churn metrics, cohort segments, and A/B tests for retention programs.
limitations: Does not connect directly to billing, email, analytics, or retention platforms.
Benchmarks are general guidance and need validation with product data.
Legal requirements vary, so teams must confirm cancellation and renewal compliance.
Best results require churn data, billing context, usage events, and customer segments.

use_cases.title: Improve Self-Serve Cancellation
use_cases.description: Design a cancellation flow that collects reasons, shows one relevant offer, and preserves a clear cancel path.

use_cases.title: Recover Failed Payments
use_cases.description: Create a dunning schedule with smart retries, payment update emails, grace periods, and recovery metrics.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Retention Work
use_cases.description: Use churn signals and cohort analysis to decide which retention fixes should be tested first.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Cancel Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a simple cancel flow for [product]. We have [plan type], [monthly price], and these common cancel reasons: [reasons].

prompt_templates.title: Map Save Offers to Reasons
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a save offer matrix for [product]. Match each cancel reason to a primary offer, fallback offer, and success metric.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Payment Recovery Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dunning program for [billing provider]. Include retry timing, email sequence, grace period policy, and recovery benchmarks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Retention System
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our churn prevention system using [churn rate], [cancel reasons], [usage signals], and [dunning recovery rate]. Prioritize experiments by impact and effort.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a cancel flow for a $29 monthly SaaS product with price-related churn.
output: A five-step flow with survey, price offer, downgrade fallback, confirmation, and reactivation path.
A 25 percent discount for three months, followed by a lower-plan option if the user declines.
Metrics for save rate, offer acceptance, and retained revenue after 60 days.

output_examples.input: A billing lead wants to recover failed Stripe payments without aggressive lockouts.
output: A smart retry plan using Stripe settings and payment update emails.
A grace period policy that pauses access before cancellation and keeps data available.
Recovery benchmarks for soft declines, hard declines, and overall failed payments.

output_examples.input: A growth team needs tests for a low cancel flow save rate.
output: A prioritized test list covering offer type, pause length, survey placement, and copy tone.
A measurement plan for save rate, long-term retention, and customer sentiment.
Guidance to test one variable at a time before expanding rollout.

best_practices: Keep the cancel option visible during every retention step.
Match each save offer to the stated reason for cancellation.
Measure saved customer LTV, not only immediate offer acceptance.
anti_patterns: Hide cancellation, add unnecessary delays, or require contact for self-serve plans.
Use the same discount for every customer and every cancel reason.
Retry hard payment declines repeatedly instead of requesting a new payment method.

faq.question: Can this skill write a complete cancel flow?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft screens, survey options, offer logic, confirmation copy, and measurement steps.

faq.question: Does it support failed payment recovery?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes dunning timelines, retry rules, email sequence guidance, and recovery metrics.

faq.question: Will it integrate with Stripe or Chargebee directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance, but it does not connect to billing providers.

faq.question: Can it help with legal compliance?
faq.answer: It can flag common cancellation and renewal issues, but legal teams must verify requirements.

faq.question: Does it recommend hiding cancellation?
faq.answer: It should not. Teams should keep cancellation clear and comply with local rules.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Founders, growth teams, customer success teams, and subscription operations managers.
